scope: CPU ray intersections against actual generated v3 geometry/instance matrices, with in-memory source trace only. Texture pixels omitted; no GPU render or runtime source edit.
limitations: Ray intersections operate on geometric surfaces, not the postprocessing AO/blur footprint
Leaf/flower triangles are opaque in this runtime, so geometric occlusion is exact apart from antialiasing/focus edges
Projected bounds are world-AABB corner bounds, not a visible-pixel silhouette
Bearing-role interpretation and replacement design are separate from raw hit facts
